sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list K2-29 and WASP-152B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 150054788545735424 and 150054788545735296), 763 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 7.0e-6: the pair is bound. No orbit of the pair is published, and the Gaia astrometry alone does not constrain one, so the star is placed by its own astrometry and carries no orbit.
